'''Goonawaro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3642 BBY]], he reported that the Empire's attempts to mine Quesh venom were slowly poisoning the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He sent a Republic spacer to destroy the Venom Tanks.
